summary: CyanBridge 2.4.0 is a large device-support, reliability, and architecture update since the last published GitHub release, v2.3.0. Recommended installation: Google Play For most users, the recommended way to install and update CyanBridge is through Google Play: Download CyanBridge from Google Play Google Play provides the simplest update path, automatic updates, and Play Protect checks. Availability of version 2.4.0 may follow the configured Play rollout. The APK attached below is intended for users who specifically need direct sideloading; the AAB is provided for Play Console and testing-track use and cannot be installed directly. Highlights More glasses, more ecosystems Added MemoMind glasses support on Android and iOS, including pairing, sessions, and a sandboxed web-plugin host. Added Mentra display-glasses support (Even Realities G1/G2, Mentra Display, Nimo, Xingyi AR99 and more), with pairing, head-up display text/dashboards, gallery download, live preview and broadcast, OTA updat
